name: Cocoa
read: Cocoa Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 4871, 94 days to expiry 2027-02-12): at-the-money implied vol 40.4%, -2.4 pts vs 2026-11-04. 20-day realized vol 37.9%, so options trade at a premium of 2.5 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +7.1 (calls over puts). Over the last 5 sessions (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-10) call open interest rose 4,410 and puts rose 4,252; put/call OI 0.44 → 0.45, front futures 5556 → 4871. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,936 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 37.6% → 39.2%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 6000 calls (4,826 lots) and 4500 puts (3,246). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 5500 calls +1,850; Mar 27 4250 puts +1,539. Biggest cut: Dec 26 5000 calls -1,164.
